products.title: PROMAT UNICABLE
products.fullDescription:
PROMAT UNICABLE is an innovative cable penetration sealing system that enables easy installation and subsequent modifications. The system provides fire resistance up to 120 minutes and is certified according to EN 1366-3.

Advantages:
- Easy installation
- Possibility of adding cables later
- Aesthetic appearance
- Long service life

products.title: PROMAT COLLAR
products.description: Fire protection collar for plastic pipes
products.fullDescription:
PROMAT COLLAR is a fire protection collar designed for sealing plastic pipe penetrations. In case of fire, the intumescent material expands and closes the opening created by the melting of the plastic pipe.

Features:
- For plastic pipes up to diameter 160mm
- Easy installation
- Fire resistance EI 120
- Certified according to EN 1366-3

products.title: Rudolf Hensel FIRESAFE
products.fullDescription:
Rudolf Hensel FIRESAFE is a premium intumescent coating for protecting steel structures from fire. The coating expands at elevated temperatures, creating an insulating layer that protects the steel.

Advantages:
- Fire resistance up to R 120
- Thin layer application
- Various finishing colors
- Certified according to EN 13381-8

specifications.coverage: Depends on profile and required resistance

products.title: PROMATECT-H
products.description: Calcium silicate board for fire protection
products.fullDescription:
PROMATECT-H is a high-performance calcium silicate board for structure protection and fire barrier construction. The board is stable, lightweight, and easy to process.

Applications:
- Steel structure cladding
- Fire barrier construction
- Cable tray protection
- Tunnel linings

products.title: PROMAT MODULAR
products.description: Modular system for complex penetration sealing
products.fullDescription:
PROMAT MODULAR is a flexible modular system for sealing complex penetrations with different types of installations. The system allows combining cables, pipes, and ducts in one penetration.

Features:
- Flexible configuration
- For all types of installations
- Easy subsequent modifications
- Fire resistance EI 120

products.title: PROMAT SYSTEMGLAS
products.description: Fire protection glass for walls and doors
products.fullDescription:
PROMAT SYSTEMGLAS is fire protection glass intended for installation in fire walls and doors. It provides transparency and safety in one.

Features:
- Fire resistance EI 30 - EI 120
- High transparency
- UV stability
- Certified according to EN 1364

products.title: PROMAT Stone Wool
products.description: Stone wool for fire protection insulation
products.fullDescription:
PROMAT stone wool is high-quality mineral wool for fire protection and thermal insulation. Ideal for use in sealing, cladding, and fire barriers.

Features:
- Melting point >1000 degrees C
- Excellent thermal insulation
- Sound insulation
- Non-combustible material

products.title: SILCA Fireplace Boards
products.fullDescription:
SILCA fireplace boards are specialized calcium silicate boards intended for safe fireplace and stove installation. They provide the necessary thermal insulation and fire resistance.

Applications:
- Insulation behind fireplaces
- Stove bases
- Building element protection
- Decorative claddings
